ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets mostly online, but may have occasional in-person meetings. You will be charged an Art + Design Facilities Fee which will grant you access to the Art + Design Facilities. This is a hybrid studio class. Students will have the option of attending in-person class once per week. And /or working remotely online asynchronously. This course is intended for first-year students in the School of Art+Design.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or Painting or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s) or minor(s).
